step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows AWS Control Tower at the center of the left section, orchestrating multi-account governance. It connects via explicit directed arrows to AWS Organizations (top-left) and AWS Service Catalog (bottom-left). A vertical dashed line separates the multi-account orchestration tools on the left from the four baseline services provisioned within each AWS account on the right: AWS Single Sign-On (IAM Identity Center), AWS Config, AWS CloudTrail, and AWS IAM.
